forecast_sentence: There is a 75% chance that, by December 31, 2029, METR will report a 50% task-completion time horizon of at least 168 human-expert hours for a publicly available general-purpose AI agent.
There is a 64% chance that at least 35% of U.S. employer firms will report using AI in any business function in the final 2028 Business Trends and Outlook Survey estimate.
There is a 46% chance that U.S. nonfarm-business labor productivity will grow by more than 2.25% annualized from 2026Q4 through 2030Q4.
There is a 58% chance that Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft will report more than $1 trillion of aggregate capital expenditure in calendar 2028.
There is a 52% chance that data centers will consume more than 12% of total U.S. electricity in calendar 2030.

There is a 78% chance that at least three independent foundry operators will be conducting commercial high-volume production on company-designated 2-nanometer-or-smaller process nodes in the United States by December 31, 2030.
There is a 39% chance that at least four facilities selected under the EU AI Gigafactories initiative will be operational and accepting compute workloads from external users by December 31, 2029.
There is an 83% chance that the average top-country refining share across copper, lithium, nickel, cobalt, graphite, and manganese will remain above 65% in 2030.
There is a 68% chance that China's annual goods trade surplus will exceed $1 trillion in at least two of the three calendar years from 2027 through 2029.
There is a 57% chance that no more than 65% of global merchandise trade will be conducted on WTO most-favored-nation terms at year-end 2029.
There is an 82% chance that the WTO Appellate Body will still lack the minimum three sitting members needed to hear an appeal on December 31, 2029.
There is a 72% chance that the annual U.S. effective tariff rate, measured as duties collected divided by customs value, will average at least 8% across calendar years 2027 through 2029.
